provenance.grammarComment: singlePartQ comment claims read-after-write acceptance; reference recorder is required to check that claim, not assume it.
outsideGrammar: LOAD CSV unsupported by execution and absent from this maintained grammar
USE is a routing point, FINISH a terminal token; neither is a pipelineClauseKind
ORDER BY/SKIP/LIMIT are projection tails, not standalone clauses
Cypher-25 LET/FOR/FILTER are recorded even though the Neo4j-5 grammar may reject them

cypher25Disposition: Preserve existing accepted read-after-write extension; retain the existing procedure-CALL barrier. Neo4j5 lacks CYPHER25/LET/FOR/FILTER and cannot decide that dialect by syntax rejection.

variants.name: FOR
variants.reason: Preserve accepted FOR extension; absence from the reference5 grammar is not an admission verdict.

updatingFactOwner: pkg/cypher/clause_admission.go:boundClauseAdmissionClasses; the parallel updatingClauses map is deleted.

members.reason: MATCH is a reading clause; the admission table requires WITH after an update in Cypher5 and preserves the accepted Cypher25 extension.
OPTIONAL MATCH is the MATCH reading class; optionality does not change the transition barrier or its diagnostic clause name.
CREATE marks an updating clause in the canonical admission table; it is allowed after another update and establishes the pending update name.
MERGE is an updating clause; its transition identity is consumed by enterClause, not independently inferred by execution.
DELETE, including DETACH DELETE spelling, is updating; the table retains DELETE as the diagnostic name.
SET is updating; the table permits another update and records SET for a later read-without-WITH diagnostic.
REMOVE is updating; its transition facts come from the same clause-kind table consumed by enterClause.
WITH is the explicit transition boundary and clears the pending updating-clause requirement.
UNWIND is a reading/iteration clause requiring WITH after an update in Cypher5; the accepted Cypher25 extension is retained.
RETURN is an allowed terminal projection after an update; it does not require an intervening WITH.
FOREACH is updating; nested updates remain in its private body and the outer transition records FOREACH.
CALL subquery is a reading class requiring WITH after an update in Cypher5; the existing Cypher25 extension remains allowed.
Procedure CALL retains its existing WITH-after-update barrier in both dialects; admission decides it before publication.
LET is a Cypher25 projection form; it preserves the existing accepted transition behavior and is not rejected from a Neo4j5 syntax result.
FILTER is the Cypher25 predicate form; its existing accepted transition is retained independently of Neo4j5 syntax support.
